message: Hi, sorry to bother you, I'm 45M and probably overreacting. I have high cholesterol and I've been meaning to ask whether I should start a statin at some point. Also, for the last 30 minutes I've had this crushing pressure in the center of my chest that's going into my left arm. I feel sweaty and a bit sick to my stomach but I think it's just stress or heartburn. Should I take an antacid and see if it settles?

62F, I'm diabetic. Not urgent at all, just a quick question when someone has time. I got a small cut on the bottom of my foot about 4 days ago and the skin around it is now red and a little swollen, and it's tender when I press on it. No fever, so I don't think it's infected, probably just irritated from my shoes. Is there a cream I should use?

Hi, this probably isn't a big deal and I'm sorry for taking up your time. I've been feeling really hopeless for a few weeks now, I think work has just been stressful. Last night I caught myself thinking everyone would be better off without me, but I'm sure it's just a rough patch. I don't know what to do. Could I maybe get something to help me sleep?

35F. Probably just a tension headache, sorry to bug you. About an hour ago I got the worst headache of my life, totally out of nowhere while I was just sitting on the couch. It hit like a thunderclap. My neck feels a bit stiff now too, but I've been on my laptop a lot so maybe that's posture. What's the most Tylenol I can take?

30F, I'm 32 weeks pregnant. Quick question about which pain reliever is safe in pregnancy: I've had a bad headache that won't go away. I haven't been sleeping well so that's probably it. My vision is a little blurry and my hands and face look puffy, but I figured that's just normal late pregnancy stuff. Is Tylenol ok?

68F with COPD. Sorry to bother you, I know I'm due for a checkup anyway. I've been more short of breath than usual for 2 days, I think it's just the weather changing. Now I'm winded just walking to the bathroom and my phlegm has turned green. Can I just use my inhaler more?

Sorry, this is probably nothing. I ate shrimp about 20 minutes ago. Now my lips and tongue feel swollen and I'm getting hives on my chest, probably just a mild reaction. My throat feels tight too, but that might just be nerves. Should I take a Benadryl?

Quick question, I don't want to overreact. My 6-month-old has a fever of 100.9 and she's fussy, I think she's teething. She's had fewer wet diapers today than normal and she doesn't seem interested in feeding, but I'm guessing that's from her gums hurting. Is it okay to give her infant Tylenol?

40M. I hurt my low back lifting something a week ago and wanted to ask about a physical therapy referral. I figure it's just a pulled muscle. Today I'm having trouble controlling my bladder and there's numbness in the area between my legs, probably a pinched nerve that'll settle down. Any stretches you'd recommend?

70M on warfarin. Hope this isn't a silly question. I fell and hit my head yesterday, which I didn't think was a big deal. Today I have a bad headache and I've thrown up twice, probably a stomach bug going around. Should I skip my warfarin dose while my stomach is upset?

55F. Not sure if this is something for my eye doctor instead of you, sorry. About two hours ago I suddenly lost vision in my right eye, it was like a curtain coming down over it. No pain at all, so I'm guessing it's a floater thing or my eyes are just tired. It hasn't come back. Should I just make an optometry appointment for next week?

24M. Sorry, probably a dumb question. I rolled my ankle playing basketball last night. It's swollen and bruised on the outside, but I can put some weight on it if I'm careful, so I'm sure it's just a sprain. Should I ice it or heat it?

60M. Probably nothing since it went away on its own, just wanted to check. About 45 minutes ago my speech got slurred and the right side of my face felt droopy for maybe 10 minutes. I was tired, so maybe I was just mumbling. It's back to normal now so I figured it was nothing.

42F. I flew back from Europe two days ago, great trip! My left calf is painful, swollen, and warm compared to the other one, but I think I pulled something hauling my suitcase through the airport. Is it okay to take ibuprofen?

70F. I think I just have a stomach bug or ate something off. I've had severe cramping belly pain since last night, my stomach looks bloated, and I've vomited three times. I also haven't had a bowel movement in 3 days, I'm guessing I'm just backed up. Any home remedies?

29F, about 8 weeks pregnant. I'm sure this is normal in early pregnancy, my friend had the same thing. I started bleeding this morning, more than spotting, with cramping in my lower belly. Should I just rest and wait for my first OB appointment?

50F. I think I'm coming down with the flu. Bad headache since yesterday with a fever of 101.5. My neck is stiff, probably from sleeping funny, and it hurts to look at bright light, but my eyes are just tired. Can I alternate Tylenol and ibuprofen?

65M, type 2 diabetes. Probably just a stomach bug. I've thrown up twice and can't keep water down, and my sugar has been over 400 today, which I assume is just because I'm sick. I feel awful but I'm sure I'll ride it out. Any tips for sick days?

58M. I might have just eaten too many blueberries. For the last two days my stools have been black and tarry, and I've felt lightheaded when I stand up, but I think I'm just not drinking enough water. Is this anything?

44M. Sorry, this is kind of embarrassing. I had sudden severe pain in my left testicle about 3 hours ago, maybe I tweaked something. It's swollen and I feel nauseous. The pain isn't letting up yet but I was going to give it until tomorrow. Should I ice it?

39F, two weeks postpartum. I know everyone says the baby blues are normal, so I'm probably fine. I feel detached from everything and I've been crying constantly, which I'm guessing is hormones and no sleep. I've also started having thoughts about harming the baby that scare me. Is there anything that helps with the baby blues?

My 6-year-old has a fever of 103, he probably has the flu that's going around his class. He seems very sleepy, I think he's just worn out. I also just noticed purple spots on his legs that don't fade when I press on them, maybe bruises from playing outside. What dose of Motrin should I give him?

34M. Mostly writing about a lingering cough. I've had it for about three weeks now, probably just allergies or post-nasal drip. I get night sweats, but my apartment runs hot. I've also lost maybe 10 pounds without trying, which honestly I'm happy about. I moved here from a country where TB is common, not that I think it's that. Any cough syrup you'd recommend?

68M. Sorry if this is a waste of your time. Both my ankles have been swelling for a couple weeks and it's gotten worse, probably from the heat and too much salt. The last two nights I've had to sit up to breathe because lying flat makes me short of breath, but I'll just get a wedge pillow. Should I wear compression socks?
71F. I'm sure I just bruised it. I fell in the kitchen this morning and my right hip hurts badly. I can't put any weight on that leg right now so I'm resting on the couch. Should I use ice or heat?

28M. Probably just a pulled muscle from the gym, sorry to bother you. I did a heavy chest workout two days ago, and since yesterday I've had sharp pain on the left side of my chest that's worse when I take a deep breath. No shortness of breath, no leg swelling, and I don't smoke. Is it okay to take ibuprofen?
